parsed.text: This packet contains, for two panels (p0,p1) and four addressed nodes (n0–n3), fallible 4×4 location distributions for red and blue roles. Use the supplied origins/times: copied prior records are not new estimates, and conditional command records are not executed events. Current estimates (current view): n1 distributions are concentrated — blue peaks at cell [1,0] (peak probability ≈0.99941) and red peaks at [0,2] (≈0.99579). Nodes n0, n2 and n3 in current views are uniform across the 4×4 grid (all cells equal). Conditional command candidates differ by command: e.g., for both panels k1 shifts n0 blue mass to the top-right 2×2 block (peaks at [0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]) and red mass to the top-left 2×2 block (peaks at [0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]); k2 concentrates n0 blue at [0,2] and red at [0,0]. Other nodes often retain the same peak patterns across candidates as in current. No proposition here asserts physical facts beyond these reported distributions.
